"Refinement Lucky Pack" Limited Time SALE. Purchase at a Special Price for Up to 3 Times a Day



"Refinement Lucky Packs" that may contain "Expert's Hammer" and other items that raise the success rate of equipment refinement will be available for purchase for a limited period of time.

Furthermore, the lucky pack that is normally priced at Orb x30, can be purchased at a special price for up to 3 times a day.
1st Purchase: Orb x15
2nd Purchase: Orb x20
3rd Purchase: Orb x25
*The special price will be reset at 4:00 PM (JST/ GMT+9).

Item Details(Tap for details)
1 item will be selected from each category below and you will get 4 items in total.

Category A

- Ultimate Expert's Hammer : Success Rate +30% for refinement at a blacksmith's. Refinement value will not be degraded even if it fails. Ore Points +2250pts
- Supreme Expert's Hammer : Success Rate +20% for refinement at a blacksmith's. Refinement value will not be degraded even if it fails. Ore Points +1500pts
- Neo Expert's Hammer : Success Rate +10% for refinement at a blacksmith's. Refinement value will not be degraded even if it fails. Ore Points +750pts
- Master Smith's Hammer : Success Rate +30% for refinement at a blacksmith's.
- Neo Smith's Hammer : Success Rate +20% for refinement at a blacksmith's.
- Refinement Ticket (1000%) : 10x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x10
- Refinement Ticket (900%) : 9x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x9
- Refinement Ticket (800%) : 8x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x8
- Refinement Ticket (700%) : 7x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x7

Category B

- Expert's Hammer : Success Rate +5% for refinement at a blacksmith's. Refinement value will not be degraded even if it fails. Ore Points +375pts
- Smith's Hammer : Success Rate +10% for refinement at a blacksmith's.
- Refinement Ticket (600%) : 6x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x6
- Refinement Ticket (500%) : 5x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x5
- Refinement Ticket (400%) : 4x Success Rate for refinement at a blacksmith's. Ore Points x4
- Refinement Ticket (+9) : If you succeed in refinement at blacksmith's using this item, the refinement value becomes +9.Unavailable for equipment with +9 or more. *Ore Points x the difference between the refinement value of the equipment and the ticket used.
- Refinement Ticket (+8) : If you succeed in refinement at blacksmith's using this item, the refinement value becomes +8.Unavailable for equipment with +8 or more. *Ore Points x the difference between the refinement value of the equipment and the ticket used.

*Ex: If you use Refinement Ticket (+3) to refine equipment with a refinement value of 0, the Ore Bonus will be tripled(x3).
If you use Refinement Ticket (+9) to refine equipment with a refinement value of 4, the Ore Bonus will be quintupled(x5).

Category C

- Insurance Ticket (100%) (Set of 10) : Prevents the equipment from degradation caused by blacksmith's refinement. It'll beused even if the refinement is successful.
- Insurance Ticket (100%) (Set of 5)
- Insurance Ticket (95%) (Set of 10) : 95% chance to prevent degradation caused by blacksmith's refinement. It'll be used even if the refinement is successful.
- Insurance Ticket (95%) (Set of 5)

Category D

- Mana Box (5,000pts) : Produces 5,000 Mana points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.
- Beast Box (10,000pts) : Produces 10,000 Beast points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.
- Fabric Box (10,000pts) : Produces 10,000 Fabric points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.
- Medicine Box (10,000pts) : Produces 10,000 Medicine points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.
- Wood Box (10,000pts) : Produces 10,000 Wood points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.
- Metal Box (10,000pts) : Produces 10,000 Metal points by using it.If the material points exceed the limit,you cannot use this item.


Sale Period

From: October 28th, 2026 at 4:00 PM (JST/GMT+9)
Until: October 31st, 2026 at 3:59 PM (JST/GMT+9)
